This is a **finding** in the frozen driver (`clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py`).

### Cause
In [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L170-L178), `explicit_selfpay` only returns `True` when the utterance matches **both** `\b(self-pay|self pay|out of pocket|pay myself)\b` and `\b(i choose|i'll pay|i will pay|i'll do|i want|choose|paying|go with|yes)\b`:
- `"I'll self-pay"` (from [Voice._selfpay](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L118-L119)) matches the first regex but fails the second.
- `"I'll pay for it myself"` (from [Voice._selfpay](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L124)) matches the second regex (`i'll pay`) but fails the first (`pay for it myself` vs. `pay myself`).
- `"That's fine, I'll just pay for it myself"` (from [Voice._selfpay](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L120-L121)) fails both.

When `explicit_selfpay` returns `None` after the self-pay prompt has been asked, [Driver.book](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L422-L431) falls back to [Driver.consent](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L264-L271), which under Arm F (`consent_in_code=True`) discards a model `"yes"` as `None`, causing `Driver.book` to re-ask via `self.unclear("selfpay", ...)` and hand off on the second attempt.

In [dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py), `explicit_selfpay` ([dcitl_port.py#L170-L178](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L170-L178)) requires both `\b(self-pay|self pay|out of pocket|pay myself)\b` and `\b(i choose|i'll pay|i will pay|i'll do|i want|choose|paying|go with|yes)\b` to return `True`.

When [Voice._selfpay](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L115-L124) emits `"I'll self-pay"` (which lacks `"i'll pay"`/`"i'll do"`) or `"I'll pay for it myself"` (which has `"for it"` between `"pay"` and `"myself"`), `explicit_selfpay` returns `None`. In [Driver.book](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L422-L431), after `asked_selfpay` is set, `Driver.consent` under Arm F (`consent_in_code=True`) ignores a model `"yes"` and returns `None`, so `Driver.book` falls through to `self.unclear("selfpay", ...)` and asks the patient again.

Because `clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py` is part of the frozen reference driver, this is a `finding`.

The issue is in the frozen driver ([dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py), mirrored from [lab23_dcitl.py.orig](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/lab23_dcitl.py.orig)).

In [`explicit_selfpay`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L170-L178), returning `True` requires matching **both** `\b(self-pay|self pay|out of pocket|pay myself)\b` **and** `\b(i choose|i'll pay|i will pay|i'll do|i want|choose|paying|go with|yes)\b`:
- `"I'll self-pay"` ([voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L118-L119)) matches the first pattern but not the second.
- `"I'll pay for it myself"` / `"That's fine, I'll just pay for it myself"` ([voice.py](file:///work/clinicbench/voice.py#L120-L124)) fail the first pattern (`pay for it myself` does not match `pay myself`).

As a result, `explicit_selfpay` returns `None`, so [`Driver.continue_wf`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L422-L432) falls back to `self.consent("selfpay", ...)`. Under Arm F (`consent_in_code=True`), [`Driver.consent`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L264-L271) discards a model `"yes"` and returns `None`, causing the driver to re-ask via `self.unclear("selfpay", ...)` and then hand off on the second unclear reply.
